name: atlas-monorepo
description: Atlas - Cross-platform file manager inspired by VSCode

scripts.electron:build: node scripts/ensure-electron.mjs && pnpm --filter @atlas/vue-desktop build:electron && pnpm run -r --filter './packages/electron-*' build
scripts.electron:compile: pnpm run electron:build && electron-builder build --config electron-builder.mjs
scripts.electron:compile:mac: pnpm run electron:build && electron-builder build --config electron-builder.mjs --mac
scripts.electron:compile:win: pnpm run electron:build && electron-builder build --config electron-builder.mjs --win
scripts.electron:compile:linux: pnpm run electron:build && electron-builder build --config electron-builder.mjs --linux
